I recently made the move from Florida to Phoenix, and I need to update my address on my account. The current Phoenix address should already be on my most recent order, so you can just pull it from there—I’m keeping the exact details a secret, like a magician who refuses to explain the trick (mostly because I don’t want to).

Also, two quick things: what’s the price of the cheapest t-shirt you have available right now, and can I order it through you? I’m shopping on a budget so tight it makes my wallet cry.

Oh, and fair warning: I don’t remember my email address, so hopefully my username or that recent order can work some verification magic!

First, though, I need to verify your identity before I can look at or change anything on an account. Since you don't have your email handy, I can look you up by **first name, last name, and zip code**.

Could you send me those three details? A couple of notes:

- If you can recall your **user id/username**, that also works as a shortcut — but I'd still need to pull up your profile by email or name + zip to authenticate.
- The zip doesn't have to be the new Phoenix one if your profile still has the Florida one — whichever is on the account will work for the lookup, and we'll update it to Phoenix afterward.

Also, just to set expectations on the other two items: once I can see your orders, I can read the shipping address off your most recent one and use that for the update. And on the t-shirt — I can look up prices and availability for you, but I'm not able to place new orders on your behalf, so that part you'd need to do yourself through the store.

Send over your name and zip whenever you're ready!
